subject: Math
subskill: Evaluate Function at a Given Value
prompt: The function f is defined by f(x)=x2−3x. What is f(12)?
explanation:
Choice A is correct. Substituting $12$ for $x$ in the given function yields $f(12)=12^{2}-3(12)$, which is equivalent to $f(12)=144-36$, or $f(12)=108$.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect and may result from an arithmetic error when subtracting $36$ from $144$.
